No KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option in the checked pools, and no one-holder Starter case exists. 脈 ばく and 荘 そ stay safe only while their three curated Starter options (脈 目 手 足; 荘 校 駅 海) fill every wrong slot; curated options on one card must not share a reading.
3 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (校舎, 艶, 翻訳) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Seven cards quiz only their on reading (翻 ホン, 脈 ミャク, 臨 リン, 興 キョウ, 舎 シャ, 荘 ソウ, 華 カ) and eight only their kun reading (翼 つばさ, 腐 くさ.る, 臭 くさ.い, 舌 した, 艶 つや, 芝 しば, 芽 め, 茂 しげ.る).

Possible word-quiz overlaps between existing word articles (芝生 and 草; 田舎 and 故郷; 別荘 and 住宅), raised in the preliminary round, are pre-existing and deferred: B149 changes those articles only by adding a link.
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.
Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology; component and stroke statements follow the pinned KanjiVG revision.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they list cards as unread that the reports say were read (all fifteen in both confirmation audits; nine of fifteen in the initial-gpt audit).
Several judgments rest partly on live reads of Digital Daijisen, Kanjipedia and Jisho pages, not on pinned copies in the packet.
Both confirmation packets' CHANGES.md describe all three lint warnings as Dictionary lines without a JMdict entry id; for 翻訳 the warning is that the article has no Dictionary: line.
